summary: Backend-only retest for iteration-9 (business rule: photos are OPTIONAL for marking a service completed). Created /app/backend/tests/test_complete_no_photos.py with 10 targeted assertions covering every requested scenario. RESULT: 10/10 PASS. Verified: (1) POST /api/services/{sid}/complete by assigned technician returns 200 and persists status='completed' with (a) NO photos, (b) only 'before' photo, (c) only 'after' photo, (d) both photos. (2) PATCH /api/services/{sid} {status:'completed'} with NO photos returns 200 for BOTH manager and admin (previously 400) and DB shows status='completed' + completed_at set. (3) Termite auto-reminder regression: firing the /complete endpoint on a Termite service with NO photos creates exactly one reminder with auto_source='termite_annual', reminder_period_months=12, source_service_id=<sid>; PATCH status='completed' on a Termite service (fresh customer to avoid the intentional +/- 2-day dedup window) also creates exactly one auto-reminder. (4) Regression: technician PATCH {status:'pending'} on a completed service returns 400 and DB stays 'completed'. (5) Regression: technician PATCH {payment_status:'paid'} on a completed service returns 200 (Cash Collection still works). Photo enforcement has been correctly and intentionally removed from both /complete and PATCH-to-completed paths per business requirement.
